title: PsychemetreAI Emotional Indicator Bank
description: Structured self-report inventory covering 9 primary emotional states with frequency, intensity, duration, impact, triggers, and adaptive coping mechanisms.

emotions.label: Anger / Frustration
emotions.description: A feeling of intense displeasure, irritation, or hostility typically provoked by perceived injustice, obstacle, or boundary violation.

emotions.label: Anxiety / Apprehension
emotions.description: A state of diffuse worry, tension, or physiological hyperarousal anticipating future uncertainty, performance, or potential threat.

emotions.label: Fear / Threat Response
emotions.description: An immediate survival-oriented emotional response to an identifiable, acute present threat or perceived danger.

emotions.label: Sadness / Dejection
emotions.description: An emotional state associated with feelings of loss, disappointment, grief, or diminished vitality.

emotions.label: Stress / Cognitive Overload
emotions.description: A state of mental or emotional strain resulting from demanding or adverse circumstances exceeding perceived coping resources.

emotions.label: Guilt / Self-Reproach
emotions.description: An internal affective tension stemming from belief that one has violated a personal moral standard or caused harm to another.

emotions.label: Jealousy / Social Comparison
emotions.description: An uncomfortable complex emotion involving resentment or fear of displacement triggered by another person's perceived advantage, success, or attention.

emotions.label: Loneliness / Disconnection
emotions.description: A painful subjective feeling of disconnection or inadequacy in emotional intimacy, belonging, or companionship.

emotions.label: Joy / Gratitude / Vitality
emotions.description: A pleasant affective state marked by feelings of contentment, deep fulfillment, celebration, or expansive connection.
